items.summary: Recommendation: Reject the new Mermaid prototype this cycle and continue only existing measurement gates, failed-request repair or closure, bounded security evidence, and the private launch gate. The fleet generated $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission for 2026-09-21, all unattributed, versus $907.46 of AI usage cost from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-25. This is not a valid contribution margin because periods and scopes differ, infrastructure and fixed costs are unavailable, and site-level revenue is $0 attributable. Cost-to-learn is also not calculable: 0 improvements are proven, 1 is measured, and 24 await measurement. The proposed candidate has only 77 impressions, 0 clicks, 0 sessions, and 0 conversions, so it is a vanity opportunity without a revenue-qualified baseline. No new finance proposal or owner decision is required this cycle.

Finance control recommendation: do not claim revenue, ROI, contribution margin, causal lift, or forecasted upside from the current evidence. The minimum future measurement for a finance-qualified test is a common dated window containing page exposure, sessions, affiliate clicks, ordered items, shipped items, commission, AI cost, infrastructure cost, and the exact content/site identifier.
